title: Chiefs' Harrison Butker drills 69-yard field goal – but that's not an NFL record

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chiefs' Harrison Butker drills 69-yard field goal – but that's not an NFL record
sources.description: A year after Jaguars' kicker Cam Little hit a 70-yard preseason field goal, Harrison Butker came one yard shy of tying him.
